global.titulo: Pablo Cansinos — Consulting, Strategy & Project Management
tema.conmutar: Switch between light and dark theme
inicio.propuesta: Consultant based in Madrid. Business diagnosis, AI adoption and international project management.
perfil.parrafo1: Business professional with experience in strategy consulting, business analysis, process improvement and project management. Comfortable in the stretch between analysis and decision: understanding how an organization works, backing it with data and proposing, with judgment, what is worth changing.
perfil.parrafo2: Currently at AiKit (Madrid) as Strategy Consultant & AI, leading diagnostic sessions with companies, analyzing their processes and operational pain points, and translating those needs into actionable recommendations built on artificial intelligence, automation, ERP and digital tools. Working directly with decision-makers —founders and business leaders— brings a cross-functional view of each company's operational, commercial and organizational challenges.
perfil.parrafo3: Previously, at Expedia Group (Prague), managed a portfolio of 180+ hotel partners, using performance, revenue, pricing and digital-positioning data to spot opportunities and recommend actions. And at ESIC University, two years coordinating international programs and European-funded projects, aligning institutions and stakeholders across different countries.
perfil.parrafo4: A profile geared toward roles in strategy, transformation, business analysis, operations and projects: settings where a business problem can be structured into practical solutions supported by technology and data.
areas.consultoria.texto: Diagnosing a company’s situation and providing recommendations for decision-makers. It’s what I do today at AiKit.
areas.procesos.texto: How work gets done today, where time is lost and what can be streamlined. I’ve done this as an operations and customer experience analyst.
areas.proyectos.texto: Coordinating projects with multiple stakeholders and following through to completion, in international settings and with partner institutions.
areas.datos.texto: Analyzing data to answer business questions and track indicators. Tools I use: Excel, Google Analytics and Looker Studio.
trayectoria.aikit.contexto: AiKit Research is a pioneering artificial-intelligence lab in Spain. A startup focused today on an AI product geared toward business automation through the creation of its own agents.
trayectoria.aikit.contribucion: As a Strategy Consultant & AI, I support companies in adopting artificial intelligence: from identifying the use case to defining prioritized, actionable roadmaps. I lead diagnostic sessions with client teams to turn operational frictions into concrete use cases, success metrics and implementation plans, which I capture in tailored diagnostic reports with prioritized, ready-to-execute recommendations. Direct work with founders and business leaders brings a cross-functional view of each company's operational, commercial and organizational challenges.
trayectoria.aikit.evidencia: 60+ companies advised and €800,000+ in consulting revenue generated through strategic advisory, in regular contact with C-level profiles at SMEs.
trayectoria.expedia.cargo: Partner Success Associate — Business Performance & Partner Advisory
trayectoria.expedia.contexto: Expedia Group works with the hotels that list their properties on the platform; the partner advisory team is their point of contact for business performance.
trayectoria.expedia.contribucion: I managed a portfolio of 180+ hotel partners: analyzing their performance on the platform —revenue, pricing and visibility— and delivering strategic recommendations to optimize it, in direct contact with each property. I advised partners on market trends, demand patterns and digital distribution strategies, and collaborated with cross-functional teams to launch performance-improvement initiatives aligned with the platform's growth targets.
trayectoria.expedia.evidencia: Portfolio of 180+ hotel partners, with 100% of KPIs achieved.
trayectoria.esic.contexto: At ESIC University, international reach is a competitive advantage: the office coordinates projects and mobility with partner institutions across five continents, with English as the working language.
trayectoria.esic.contribucion: As head of the international area, I managed international projects end to end —among them the Erasmus+ Blended Intensive Programs (BIP)— coordinating partner universities across the five continents. I formalized inter-institutional agreements, administered European funds and organized events —International Weeks and private programs—, as well as representing the institution at European Commission fairs (the Erasmus+ Regional Meeting in Panama City and ERACON in Rome). In parallel, I led the mobility of international students and staff (administrative and teaching) between institutions.
trayectoria.esic.evidencia: 700+ students a year, 80+ staff mobilities and €130,000 in grants managed.
trayectoria.orange.contribucion: I supported the shift to an omnichannel sales model through channel analysis, reporting and coordination across sales management, distributors and partner outlets. I built Excel databases that streamlined CRM testing and process management for public and SME clients.
trayectoria.gmp.texto: Customer experience analysis: I drove user engagement with personalized support over email, events and webinars, and strengthened relationships with strategic stakeholders. I designed promotional campaigns from multichannel data analysis that grew the user base by 27% in two months.
trayectoria.payflow.texto: I built the customer service and operations department from scratch, under the direct supervision of the vice-president. I designed a semi-automated WhatsApp acquisition process that grew the user base by more than 170% and raised app adoption from 18% to 27%.
proyectos.intro: Almas Inquietas is a grassroots collective that turns sport into social impact. It runs charity tournaments and challenges that bring a community together and direct the funds raised to a specific cause, always channelled through an established social organization. I take part as an associate member in organizing its events.
proyectos.futbol.texto: Charity football tournament organized with Almas Inquietas in support of Ideorama, an association that works with children and families on education, responsible use of technology and healthy leisure. A day of sport and community in which I took part in the organization.
proyectos.futbol.foto1.alt: Attendees gathered by an Almas Inquietas stand at the charity football tournament.
proyectos.futbol.foto2.alt: The tournament team wearing medals next to the Ideorama banner.
proyectos.futbol.patrocinadores: Supported by Día, Telepizza, Pozuelo Town Council and other sponsors.
proyectos.padel.texto: ‘The Mindful Padel’, the collective’s second tournament, played in pairs at Club de Pádel Bularas (Pozuelo de Alarcón). The funds raised went to Fundación Blas Méndez Ponce —which helps children with cancer and hard-to-treat illnesses— in collaboration with Ideorama.
proyectos.padel.foto1.alt: Poster for the ‘The Mindful Padel’ charity tournament.
proyectos.padel.foto2.alt: Sponsor MG Albión Motor’s car on display at the tournament.
proyectos.padel.patrocinadores: Supported by MG Albión Motor, Padel Bularas, Minigymrats, Cañas y Tapas, Día, Herbalife and other sponsors.
proyectos.rtw.texto: Almas Inquietas’ most ambitious challenge to date. Alex, co-founder, will ride from Prague to Madrid by bike: nine countries, 4,000 km. We built a community on Strava where anyone can add kilometres under the idea of ‘one kilometre, one euro’; the goal is to raise €4,000 for Fundación Verón’s school-meals program, which trains children in Honduras: that amount covers a whole class’s school meals for an entire school year.
proyectos.rtw.contribucion: The project runs on digital tools and artificial intelligence: a real-time kilometre counter connected to Strava, a website that follows the route stage by stage, and a crowdfunding campaign, with Fundación Verón’s support in communications, social media and management.
proyectos.rtw.foto1.alt: Ride the Wave jersey showing the Fundación Verón logos.
proyectos.rtw.foto2.alt: Touring bike loaded for the trip, camped at sunset.
trayectoria.n2growth.texto: I supported the director in executive search: market and company research, candidate mapping and building structured prospect databases. I helped prepare client presentations aligned with the firm's positioning.
